functions.cheongla_private.is_principal:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.is_principal()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.cheongla_profiles where id=auth.uid() and approval_status='approved' and membership_state='active' and role in('owner','english_director','math_director'));
$function$
functions.cheongla_private.can_manage_life:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.can_manage_life()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select cheongla_private.can_use_member_services()and exists(select 1 from public.cheongla_profiles where id=auth.uid()and approval_status='approved'and membership_state='active'and(role in('owner','english_director','math_director','manager')or is_app_admin));
$function$
functions.cheongla_private.can_read_learning:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.can_read_learning(k text, s uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select cheongla_private.can_use_member_services() and case when k='registration' then cheongla_private.can_manage_life() when k in('study','external') then cheongla_private.can_manage_exams() or exists(select 1 from public.cheongla_profiles p where p.id=s and p.role='student' and p.approval_status='approved' and p.membership_state='active' and (s=auth.uid() or cheongla_private.is_parent_of(s))) else false end;
$function$
functions.cheongla_private.send_notification:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.send_notification(people uuid[], kind text, target uuid, student uuid, label text, destination text, event_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 insert into public.cheongla_notifications(recipient_id,source_kind,source_id,student_id,title,route,event_key)
 select p.id,kind,target,student,label,destination,event_id
 from public.cheongla_profiles p where p.approval_status='approved' and p.membership_state='active'
 and p.id=any(people)
 on conflict(recipient_id,event_key) do nothing;
$function$
functions.cheongla_private.can_use_mbti_study:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.can_use_mbti_study()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.cheongla_profiles
    where id=(select auth.uid())
    and approval_status='approved'
  );
$function$
functions.cheongla_private.can_read_notification:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cheongla_private.can_read_notification(kind text, target uuid, student uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
 when kind='staff_journal'then cheongla_private.can_use_staff_journal()and exists(select 1 from cheongla_private.journal_notification_events where id=target)
 when kind='director_post'then exists(select 1 from public.cheongla_director_posts where id=target and state='published'and archived_at is null)
 when kind='account_recovery'then cheongla_private.can_manage_account_recovery()and exists(select 1 from cheongla_private.account_help_requests where id=target)
 when kind='winter_booking'then exists(select 1 from cheongla_private.winter_bookings r where r.id=target and r.archived_at is null and(cheongla_private.can_manage_winter()or(cheongla_private.can_use_member_services()and r.owner_id=auth.uid())))
 else cheongla_private.can_read_notification_before_winter(kind,target,student)end;
$function$
functions.public.cheongla_mbti_operation_students:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cheongla_mbti_operation_students()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not cheongla_private.can_manage_mbti_operations() then raise insufficient_privilege; end if;
  return query select p.id, p.full_name from public.cheongla_profiles p
    where p.role = 'student' and p.approval_status = 'approved' and p.membership_state = 'active'
    order by p.full_name, p.id;
end;
$function$
